findings.title: Cache fill is not rechecked under the write lock
findings.body: GetWebAssets drops the read lock and then takes the write lock without checking entryPointAssetsCache again. Concurrent cold calls (and any Dev reload) all proceed to read the manifest and then unconditionally assign entryPointAssetsCache = result, including when result is nil because the read failed. A failing caller can therefore wipe a cache that another goroutine just populated, and return an error even though a valid snapshot already existed. Later non-Dev requests miss the cache and stampede on disk again. Re-read the pointer after Lock and return the existing value when Env is not Dev and the cache is already non-nil; only publish a new pointer on success.
